Emergency crews worked through the night to clear the wreckage and set up a temporary morgue for victim identification. The incident marks Spain's second deadly train crash this year, prompting Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez to call for a full investigation into the safety of the rail network as the country enters three days of mourning.

This victory marks the culmination of nearly six decades of aspirations for the team, which was founded as an expansion franchise 57 years ago. The decisive game took place at Tropicana Field in Tampa, celebrating a significant achievement for the Brewers and their fans.

The Brewers scheduled a free Parade of Champions and downtown celebration for Oct. 30 in the immediate aftermath of the victory.
